description: Browse or search canonical employers, associations, schools, or worship organizations that appear in positive conditions in current active eligibility publications. Omit query to browse by active-publication graph connectivity; that order is NOT popularity, quality, or a recommendation. With query, normalized exact matches rank before bounded prefix matches. A returned organization is a selectable fact, NOT proof that this person can join any credit union; use resolve_eligibility_entities for authoritative selection, then pass the returned org_id in the matching *_org_ids field to an eligibility tool. This authenticated discovery never loads a client-side corpus and accepts no personal profile.

limit.description: Maximum results; the response discloses truncation.

query.description: Optional organization name or prefix, 2-120 characters. Omit to browse by active-publication connectivity.

types.description: Exact public organization types to search. Omit for all four types.

name: search_eligibility_entities

outputSchema.description: Bounded canonical organization discovery backed only by positive conditions in active publications.

disclosure.description: Required warning that organization discovery does not prove eligibility.

normalized_query.description: Canonical normalized text used for indexed exact and prefix matching.

query.description: Trimmed search text supplied by the caller.

query_truncated.description: Whether the accepted query text was truncated; currently always false because oversized input is rejected.

result_mode.description: search for text-ranked results or most_connected for query-less graph-connectivity browse; neither is an eligibility verdict.

results.description: Deterministically ranked canonical entity matches; these do not imply personal eligibility.

active_institution_count.description: Active institutions whose publications positively reference this entity.

active_rule_count.description: Current active-publication positive rules referencing this entity.

last_confirmed_at.description: Latest derivable publication-bound confirmation timestamp, or null.

match_confidence.description: Alias and method confidence from 0 to 1; not eligibility confidence.

match_method.description: normalized_exact, normalized_prefix, or canonical_id for query-less browse.

matched_alias.description: Stored alias that produced this match.

org_id.description: Stable canonical organization identifier; identical to entity_id.

results_truncated.description: True when more authorized matches existed than were returned.

types.description: Exact public entity types included in the search.
